verdict.rationale: Calendly documents a REST-based public API v2 with resource-oriented URLs. It supports personal access tokens and OAuth 2.1, and lets you read and write scheduling data, book meetings end-to-end, and query availability. Webhook subscriptions with signing keys round it out, and probes confirm agent-friendly docs (llms.txt, Markdown versions of every page). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of actually driving the API, since all API evidence is first-party documentation.
